## Summary

Describe the change and the user-facing or maintainer-facing reason for it.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:python`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run playground:build`
- [ ] `npm run pack:dry`
- [ ] `npm run smoke:install`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace --locked`

## Determinism impact

- [ ] No deterministic behavior changed
- [ ] Deterministic behavior changed and fixtures/docs were updated

## Release impact

- [ ] No package release required
- [ ] Patch release
- [ ] Minor release
- [ ] Major release
